text: The cost to the government for conducting this collection of information stems from the electronic processing of up to 3,000 FFDO applications every year.  TSA estimates an application will take three minutes (0.05 hours) for a TSA employee to review, for an annual hour burden of 150 hours.  In addition, a TSA employee will spend ten minutes (0.17 hours) to conduct the interview, for an annual hour burden of 500 hours.  The total TSA annual hour burden for this collection is 650 hours.

text: The unweighted wage rate for Aircraft Pilots and Flight Engineers is $72.50.  BLS.  May 2017 National Industry-Specific Occupational Employment and Wage Estimates.  NAICS 481000 - Air Transportation. OCC 53-2010 Aircraft Pilots and Flight Engineers.  Last modified March 30, 2018 (accessed July 24, 2018), https://www.bls.gov/oes/2017/May/naics3_481000.htm.  TSA calculates a compensation factor by dividing the total compensation ($28.40) by the Salaries and Wages component of compensation ($18.77) to calculate a compensation factor of 1.51305 ($28.40 ÷ $18.77).  BLS.  Employer Costs for Employee Compensation - March 2018.  Table 5. Employer costs per hour worked for employee compensation and costs as a percent of total compensation: private industry workers. Production, transportation and material moving occupations.  Last modified June 8, 2018 (accessed July 24, 2018), https://www.bls.gov/news.release/archives/ecec_06082018.htm.  The fully-loaded wage rate therefore is the unloaded wage rate multiplied by the compensation factor. $109.70 = $72.50 x 1.51305.
